title: Asked: Free AEO And GEO Question Finder For B2B Content
description: Asked is a free, open-source AEO and GEO question finder for B2B content. Enter a keyword to see the questions AI search will ask about it, each labelled with the evidence behind it (Confirmed, Search Demand or Predicted Fan-Out), shaped into a content brief. This release includes the Asked Method and the Citable Passage Standard. Live site: https://archanacontent.github.io/asked/
